name: nest-api
title: NestJS API
description: NestJS 12 + Prisma (Postgres) + Redis + BullMQ + better-auth + Vitest, with Docker Compose for local Postgres/Redis and a Scalar API reference.

prisma.title: Prisma ORM + Postgres
prisma.description: PrismaService, multi-file schema, the .bin/db.ts env-aware wrapper, and the Prisma exception filters.

config.title: Zod-validated config service
config.description: CustomConfigService wrapping @nestjs/config; app code never reads process.env directly.

auth.title: better-auth (email/password, OAuth, roles)
auth.description: Global AuthGuard so every route is authenticated by default, @AllowAnonymous to opt out, access-control statements and roles in lib/access.ts.

cache.title: Redis cache
cache.description: CacheService on ioredis, plus the key-namespacing helpers. Required by the queue, throttler and realtime layers.

queue.title: BullMQ background jobs
queue.description: QueueModule.register(), the Bull Board dashboard at /dashboard behind basic auth.

mail.title: Transactional email
mail.description: MailService enqueuing onto the `mail` queue, a MailProcessor consumer, and React Email templates with a dev preview server.

rate-limit.title: Two-layer rate limiting
rate-limit.description: ThrottlerGuard on a Redis Lua storage for app routes, plus better-auth's own limiter for /auth/* with per-endpoint rules.

openapi.title: OpenAPI + Scalar reference
openapi.description: Swagger document at /openapi and a Scalar UI at /docs (auth + main API), both behind basic auth. Core rather than optional: @ApiTags/@ApiProperty decorators are pervasive in the controller and entity conventions, so removing @nestjs/swagger would mean annotating hundreds of lines.

observability.title: Observability: OpenTelemetry and health checks
observability.description: OpenTelemetry traces, logs and metrics pushed over OTLP (built for OpenObserve; set OPENOBSERVE_URL/ORG/TOKEN, or any OTEL_* backend), plus Terminus health checks with a Prisma indicator. Off at runtime until connected.

users.title: Users module
users.description: Admin-style user listing/lookup gated by permissions, plus the authenticated user's own /me resource and avatar upload.

media.title: File uploads (S3)
media.description: MediaService and S3Service for public and private uploads, with multipart decorators.

scheduler.title: Cron / interval scheduling
scheduler.description: @nestjs/schedule wired at the root so modules can declare @Cron and @Interval jobs.

http-client.title: Outbound HTTP client
http-client.description: @nestjs/axios registered with a default timeout, for calling third-party APIs.

realtime.title: Socket.IO realtime layer
realtime.description: An authenticated gateway, Redis-backed presence, a Redis Socket.IO adapter for horizontal scale, and WS auth/permission guards. Opt-in.

notifications.title: Persistent user notifications
notifications.description: A Notification model plus dispatch/read endpoints. Pushes each new notification over the realtime layer when that feature is also on, and persists either way.

feature-flags.title: GrowthBook feature flags
feature-flags.description: A session-aware FeatureFlagGuard and FeatureFlagService for gating routes on flags.

temporal.title: Temporal client
temporal.description: A TemporalService for starting and querying durable workflows (multi-step, long-waiting or crash-resumable work; BullMQ stays for fire-and-forget jobs), plus Temporal's dev server in compose.yml. Pair it with node-worker or py-worker built --with temporal to run the workflows. Connects lazily, so the API runs while Temporal is down.

graphql.title: GraphQL endpoint
graphql.description: Code-first GraphQL via Apollo, registered alongside the REST controllers. Resolvers in any feature module are picked up automatically.

testing.title: Vitest unit + e2e suites
testing.description: Two Vitest projects, an AppFactory that boots the real app against real Postgres and Redis, and a test Docker stack.

docker.title: Docker Compose + image
docker.description: compose.yml running Postgres and Redis for local dev, a production Dockerfile, and the .bin/dc.ts stack wrapper.

ci.title: Forgejo Actions CI
ci.description: A workflow that spins up the test stack and runs both Vitest projects on pull requests.

secrets.title: Infisical secret sync
secrets.description: `yarn secrets -e <env>` pulls the matching .env file instead of passing secrets around by hand.

hooks.title: format (the feature strip leaves valid but unformatted code)
git init
hooks.run: git init -q && git add -A && git commit -qm 'chore: scaffold {{name}} from the nest-api template'
